summary: TREDI pass-4: focused test of the new DUPLICATE-INVOICE (repeat purchase) feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (test_duplicate_invoice.py, run with -n 0 because parallel workers on gw0/gw1 mutate the same shared items table and cause a false stock-drift). Covered — GET /api/invoices/{id}/duplicate returns source_number/customer/lines/totals/repriced[]/short[]/times_repeated; ?update_prices=false keeps the source unit prices (repriced=[]) and ?update_prices=true rewrites unit_price from the item's current selling_price; unknown id -> 404. POST /api/invoices/{id}/duplicate {issue:true,update_prices:true} — new invoice gets a fresh sequential INV number, duplicated_from + duplicated_from_number are set, PAYMENTS ARE NOT COPIED (paid=0), stock decrements by line.quantity on the source item AND a 'sale' movement is written referencing the new INV number, source.duplicate_count increments. POST with {issue:false} — creates a status='draft' invoice numbered 'Draft' and does NOT touch stock. Duplicating twice back-to-back yields two new sequential INV numbers and duplicate_count==2 on the source. Regression: POST /api/invoices (from-scratch) still returns issued/decorated invoices and /api/invoices still lists them all. Frontend on 390x844 (owner@tredi.app): opened INV-1003 from Sales list; both invoice-more (top-right copy icon) AND the invoice-duplicate row open testID=invoice-duplicate-sheet; the sheet shows testID=duplicate-preview '3 lines · Blessing Adeyemi ₦ 84,000'. Toggling testID=duplicate-use-prices flips the switch (preview total didn't move here because the items' current selling_price == the price stored on INV-1003 for those lines; not a bug — confirmed against the backend preview payload which returned repriced=[]). testID=duplicate-issue creates the new invoice, lands directly on /invoices/<new-id> and the header shows the 'Repeat of INV-1003' badge. testID=duplicate-edit opens /invoices/new?from=<src-id> pre-filled — step indicator sits on '2 Items' (past customer selection), customer 'Blessing Adeyemi' is pre-selected via a 'Change' pill, and the 3 original lines (Adeba Rice 50kg 1x62,000, Cooking Oil 5L 2x9,800, Delivery within Lagos 1x2,400 = ₦84,000) are pre-loaded. testID=invoice-chip-duplicate label 'Repeat 18' filters the Sales list to 14 currently visible rows (of 18 total) and every visible row shows the 'repeat of INV-xxxx' subtag as required. Duplicate detail page also renders '3 Items' with '+ ₦ 84,000' total, and rows in the filtered Sales list include Drafts too (e.g. 'Draft · repeat of INV-1026'), which matches the sales.tsx logic (filter is based on !!i.duplicated_from, not on status). LOW fixes from iteration_3: verified card-save testID alias is not directly re-tested here because the review deferred it; shortcuts.tsx save no longer crashes with GO_BACK when opened directly (checked by inspection: file now guards with router.canGoBack()).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/invoicing.py:254-270 — _repeat_lines correctly rehydrates each source line from items collection: when update_prices is False the original unit_price is preserved; when True it is overwritten with item.selling_price and the price_changed flag drives the frontend 'repriced' hint. Good separation of preview vs. write.

/app/backend/routes/invoicing.py:293-318 — POST does not copy payments/reminders/history (only the basket, terms, discount config, shop, note). It correctly gates stock movement AND activity write behind data.issue (drafts stay quiet), and duplicate_count on the source is $inc'd atomically. next_number() drives numbering so parallel duplicates get distinct sequential INV numbers.

/app/frontend/app/invoices/[id].tsx:29-129 — repeat state, useQuery preview (enabled: repeat), issue mutation with router.replace to the new invoice, plus separate 'Edit before saving' branch pushing /invoices/new?from=<id>. All 5 testIDs present: invoice-more, invoice-duplicate, invoice-duplicate-sheet, duplicate-preview, duplicate-use-prices, duplicate-issue, duplicate-edit — matches the review request.

/app/frontend/app/invoices/new.tsx:68-100 — repeatQ effect populates customer + lines from the duplicate preview and advances the wizard past the customer step; verified visually (step 2 highlighted, Blessing Adeyemi with Change pill, 3 rows loaded).

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/sales.tsx:14-67, 96 — Repeat chip counts !!i.duplicated_from and the row tag prints 'repeat of <duplicated_from_number>'. Chip label 'Repeat 18' matched the 18 duplicated rows in the underlying list.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 duplicate-invoice pytest cases pass serially; parallel workers on shared items cause a false-positive stock delta, so pytest -n 0 is used for this file)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical duplicate-invoice flows verified: sheet open via invoice-more, sheet open via invoice-duplicate row, preview card, use-prices toggle, duplicate-issue → Repeat-of badge on new invoice, duplicate-edit → /invoices/new?from=<id> pre-filled, Repeat chip filter, 'repeat of INV-xxxx' row tag.

seed_data_creation: Backend suite created a small number of extra INV-* invoices on the owner's Tredi Ventures business (repeatable seed helper _create_seed_invoice_for_duplicate + several duplicate-issue calls). These are non-destructive additions to demo data; the source_number test also incremented the source invoice's duplicate_count during the two-in-a-row test. No customers/items were mutated beyond stock decrements that mirror real sales.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL https://ui-flow-accurate.preview.preview-host.app. Sign in via testIDs sign-in-email / sign-in-password / sign-in-submit (Field renders the input directly at the testID node, so page.fill('[data-testid=sign-in-email]', ...) works — do NOT chain ' input'). If the app boots to onboarding, click text 'Skip' first. For duplicate flow: Sales tab → open any invoice-row-INV-* → invoice-more or invoice-duplicate opens invoice-duplicate-sheet → duplicate-preview + duplicate-use-prices + duplicate-issue + duplicate-edit. Repeat filter: invoice-chip-duplicate. Backend: run test_duplicate_invoice.py with `pytest -n 0` to avoid parallel-worker stock interference on the shared items collection (pytest.ini enables xdist by default). The '+' FAB is testID=tab-fab → opens fab-sheet → fab-new-invoice route to /invoices/new.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial pytest failures during authoring were both test-harness issues, not app bugs: (1) /api/activity returns {rows,shops,people,kinds,label} (dict), not a bare list, so the initial e.get('subtitle') iteration blew up — fixed to read payload['rows'] and use the 'sub' field. (2) decorate_invoice repaints status to 'unpaid'|'part_paid'|'paid' on issued invoices, so the assertion `status == 'issued'` was over-strict — relaxed to accept the decorated statuses. Both fixes are in the test file only; the backend response contracts are correct.
